explication: Dear ImGui is a platform-agnostic immediate-mode C++ GUI library. An application feeds platform events, creates a frame, emits widgets and tool content, then receives optimized draw lists for a renderer backend to submit to a graphics API. The core also manages layout, interaction, tables, fonts, and reusable UI state. Platform and renderer integrations are modular; FreeType is an optional font-building path. Some relationships are inferred from documented architecture because most core implementations were not sampled.
